name: Claude Code Game Studios
summary: A repository that turns Claude Code into a game-making setup with many specialised agents and workflow skills. You describe a game idea, answer a few questions, review a one-page brief, and it builds a first playable browser prototype that it checks before handing it over.
install_steps: Open Claude Code in a copy of the repository
Describe the game you want with the /prototype command
Answer the short round of questions, or let it pick the answers
Read the one-page brief it writes to design/game-brief.md and approve it or ask for changes
Open the generated prototype from the prototypes folder in a browser
example_use_case: You have a rough idea for a small browser game, such as a fishing game where rare fish only bite at dusk, and want a playable first version to react to before writing any code yourself.
